BiblicalUsage: Oniy is a ship, or a fleet, a navy. Solomon makes a navy of ships in Ezion-geber in 1 Kings 9:26, on the shore of the Red Sea, and Isaiah 33:21 promises a place of broad rivers where no galley with oars and no gallant ship shall pass.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ships of Solomon are the strength of a kingdom, and the rivers of Isaiah are the peace of a kingdom no ship can threaten.
